Other EventsOn May 8, 2026, the Company entered into token purchase agreements (each, a “Token Purchase Agreement”) with certain institutional investors (collectively, the “Investors”), led by a16z crypto, pursuant to which the Company agreed to issue and sell to the Investors an aggregate of 740 million ARC tokens (the “ARC Tokens”), in a presale of the native coordination asset of the Company’s Arc blockchain network. The offer and sale of the ARC Tokens pursuant to the Token Purchase Agreements was conducted as a private placement exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, pursuant to Section 4(a)(2) thereof and Rule 506(b) of Regulation D promulgated thereunder.
